disclaimer: Curated from published 2026 social media benchmark reports: Socialinsider's 2026 Engagement Benchmarks (analysis of ~70M posts), the Rival IQ/Quid 2026 Social Media Industry Benchmark Report (18 industries tracked), DataReportal's Digital 2026 report, and Sprout Social's 2026 Best Times to Post study (~2B engagements across ~307,000 profiles, Nov 2025-Feb 2026). Two engagement-rate figures are given per platform where the two benchmark reports disagree (they use different methodologies/sample sets) - both are real published numbers, not an invented average. Directional planning figures, not guarantees; refresh periodically via maintainer review, not live scraping.
sources: Rival IQ / Quid 2026 Social Media Industry Benchmark Report
Sprout Social 2026 Best Times to Post on Social Media

instagram.demographic_note: No single dominant age band; skews younger in most Western markets - Instagram is frequently cited as the 'favourite' platform among younger users
instagram.dominant_format: Reels/short-form video - Reels drive over 20% of total time spent on the platform

tiktok.demographic_note: Youngest average user age of any major platform (26.5 yrs); 66% of users aged 18-34; fastest-growing segment is 50+ (+240% since 2023)

facebook.demographic_note: Only major platform where users 35+ outnumber under-35s; strongest with 65+ but broadly popular across all age groups

linkedin.demographic_note: 25-34 age group makes up 60% of users; the strongest B2B platform - an estimated 65M decision-makers and 10M C-level executives are active on it
linkedin.dominant_format: Text posts and document/carousel posts, thought-leadership style

youtube.demographic_note: Broad reach across nearly all age groups

x.demographic_note: General audience; posting volume up ~40% YoY in 2026 even as per-post engagement stayed low

industry_engagement_notes._note: Qualitative relative-performance signal from the Rival IQ/Quid 2026 report (18 tracked industries), mapped to this app's industry keys where a reasonable match exists. Industries not listed here have no specific signal in that report - treat as platform-median.
industry_engagement_notes.education: Leads Facebook engagement and dominates TikTok, at roughly 2x the platform median engagement rate.
industry_engagement_notes.b2b_saas: Leads LinkedIn engagement at roughly 1.5x the platform median engagement rate - the strongest-performing category on that platform.
industry_engagement_notes.beauty_personal_care: Had the lowest engagement across platforms in the 2026 report, in a saturated content category.
industry_engagement_notes.ecommerce_retail: Tracked as 'Retail' - had the lowest engagement across platforms alongside Beauty in the 2026 report.
industry_engagement_notes.restaurants_food: Highest YouTube engagement of any tracked industry, by a significant margin.
industry_engagement_notes.technology_electronics: Underperforms the median on YouTube specifically.
industry_engagement_notes.finance_insurance: Underperforms the median on YouTube specifically.
industry_engagement_notes.travel_hospitality: Tracked as 'Hotels & Resorts' - a consistently strong-performing category alongside Sports and Higher Education.
industry_engagement_notes.automotive: Directly tracked in the 2026 report; performance is mid-pack, no standout over/under-performance flagged.
industry_engagement_notes.apparel_fashion: Tracked as 'Fashion' in the 2026 report; performance is mid-pack, no standout over/under-performance flagged.
industry_engagement_notes.nonprofit: Tracked as 'Nonprofits' in the 2026 report; performance is mid-pack, no standout over/under-performance flagged.
